I certify the information provided is true and correct. I am requesting mortgage assistance because the hardship described above has reduced my ability to make the full contractual payment.

documents.title: Hardship Statement
body: I am writing to request assistance with my mortgage. In January 2026 I was diagnosed with a long-term illness that has kept me from working full hours, reducing my household income from $9,200 to about $7,000 per month.
After exhausting my savings on medical costs, I can no longer afford the full payment of $3,205 (principal, interest, and escrow). I want to keep my home and can sustain a lower, affordable payment.
I have enclosed my disability verification and most recent pay stubs. Thank you for considering my application.
